description: You are marooned on the shores of an infinite blocky world. Explore, mine resources, craft tools and weapons, build traps and grow plants. Dress up and hunt animals for food and resources. Build a shelter to survive the cold nights and share your worlds online. Driving a horse, camel or axle and a herd of cattle to protect them from predators. Blast your way through the rock. Build complex electrical devices. The possibilities are endless in this long-running series of sandbox survival and building games.
